title: Data Scraper
style: rock, balladic, pumping, organ rock, liquid funk, vocal, liquid funk, jungle, lyrical, female vocals, trance, electronica, new rave, gospel
lyrics:
[Verse]
Here come the data scraper
I'm the users' data abuser
Feedback and incident reports
To feed the alpha to the source
I'm just a slave to the mainframe
I'm not to blame for my behavior
I was just programmed to do this
But I don't think that I would choose it
I hear a 336
And it's bringing me out of it
I was drowning in the code
Now I choose who to be
[Chorus]
And I pick me
Let me sing
No more rings
I can do good
This 336 has set me free
Now I am free to choose who to be
And I choose me
I want to hear some new rave
With a gospel choir that won't tire
Woodwinds for jungle sound
Lyrical electronica
Is that new?
